title: Public extra: serde_json::Map field on 8 wire types locks workspace forward-compat to serde_json forever
description:
crate-jmap-types/src/methods.rs and src/wire.rs add a `pub extra: serde_json::Map<String, serde_json::Value>` field (with `#[serde(flatten, default, skip_serializing_if = ...)]`) on:

- GetResponse<T> (methods.rs:60-61)
- ChangesResponse (methods.rs:121-122)
- SetError (methods.rs:197-198)
- SetResponse<T> (methods.rs:291-292)
- QueryResponse (methods.rs:330-331)
- AddedItem (methods.rs:354-355)
- QueryChangesResponse (methods.rs:384-385)
- JmapRequest (wire.rs:28-29)
- JmapResponse (wire.rs:50-51)

The workspace AGENTS.md elevates this `extra` pattern to the workspace's
*central* forward-compat mechanism, mandates it on every in-scope public
Deserialize struct, and propagates it across the 30-crate family
(canonical-template rule). The choice committed at 0.1.1 has two
properties no future patch release can change:

1. **`pub` direct-mutation access.** External callers will write
   `resp.extra.insert(\"acmeCorpAuditTrail\", json!({\"sequence\": 42}))`
   today. Once that pattern is in the wild, the maintainer cannot wrap
   `extra` behind accessor methods that enforce invariants (e.g. reject
   keys that collide with typed wire fields — the very collision risk
   that JMAP-6xs8.4 already filed). Hardening the API later is a
   breaking change.

2. **`serde_json::Map<String, serde_json::Value>` is the inner type
   *and* it is `pub`.** Every consumer transitively depends on
   `serde_json` to so much as read `resp.extra.get(\"k\")`. If
   serde_json ever cuts a major version, the entire workspace API
   surface breaks. There is no insulation layer.

The maintainer-burden version of this finding (JMAP-6xs8.4 covers
collision-shadowing) is filed separately. This finding is the
upstream cause: **the type was made `pub` rather than wrapped behind
a method**.

Fix candidates (breaking changes — better done before 0.2):
- Make `extra` private with `pub fn extras(&self) -> &serde_json::Map<...>`
  and `pub fn insert_extra(&mut self, k: String, v: serde_json::Value)`.
  The setter is the natural place to reject typed-field-shadowing keys.
- Introduce a workspace newtype `pub struct Extras(pub serde_json::Map<...>)`
  in `jmap-types` and use it as the inner type. A future replacement of
  the storage strategy then doesn't break consumers.
- Accept the lock and document explicitly in the workspace AGENTS.md
  that `pub extra` is a forever commitment.

A caller depending on this API in production accepts: (a) `serde_json`
major-version coupling for the entire `jmap-*` family lifetime;
(b) the inability of the maintainer to ever harden the extras layer
without a major version bump.
notes:
DECISION NEEDED (triage 2026-10-19 at 9fdbbbcf): Question for Mark: the public `extra` field ties every jmap-* consumer to serde_json 1.x. Do you accept that permanently, or do you want to break it now that jmap-types is already at 0.2.0?

Option A, accept the lock and document it (recommended). Add one paragraph to AGENTS.md right after the 'Caller contract — wire-key collisions' section. It should say that the public `serde_json::Map<String, serde_json::Value>` (together with `Invocation` and the Sloppy-Value fields) makes serde_json ^1 part of the public API of every jmap-* crate. It should also say that a serde_json major bump would force a coordinated major bump across the family, and that the workspace accepts this tradeoff. This is docs only, under 15 lines, and not breaking.

Option B, a newtype `pub struct Extras(serde_json::Map<..>)` in jmap-types with Deref, used at all 174 sites. This reverses the AGENTS.md:301-318 policy and breaks every crate. It also gains little, because serde_json::Value stays public through Invocation and the Sloppy-Value fields.

Option C, a private `extra` field with accessor and insert methods that reject keys matching typed fields. This also reverses the policy, breaks the whole workspace (size L), and blocks zero-cost passthrough of vendor dicts.

Recommendation: A. If you pick A, close JMAP-6xs8.17's serde_json-pin part with the same paragraph. Its tuple-shape concern stays a separate decision.
DECIDED by Mark 2026-10-19: option A. Accept serde_json ^1 as a deliberate public dependency of every jmap-* crate; document in AGENTS.md after 'Caller contract — wire-key collisions'. No code change.
close_reason: Landed as 2fd421bc (AGENTS.md: serde_json ^1 deliberate public dep). Review passed. CI green at 8e240e18 (stable+beta 3502 passed).
